listing.contract: list_issues(issues, status=None, page=1, page_size=2) returns a list of matching issue dictionaries. Inputs are well-formed dictionaries with id, title and status. Preserve order and do not mutate the input. status=None includes all issues; any other status uses exact matching. Filter before pagination. Pages are one-based. page and page_size must be positive integers, excluding booleans; invalid values including strings and nonintegral numbers raise ValueError. Empty input, an unmatched status, and a page past the end return []. Satisfy the complete contract even when the task highlights one regression.

labels.contract: normalize_labels(labels) returns canonical labels as a list. labels must be a Python list and every entry must be a string; all invalid containers or entries raise ValueError. Collapse whitespace with split/join semantics, Unicode-casefold each label, discard empty canonical results and deduplicate while preserving first occurrence order. Do not mutate any input, including on errors.

updates.contract: update_issue(issues, issue_id, changes) returns issue dictionaries in their original order with only the selected issue patched. issues is a well-formed list with unique positive integer IDs, nonblank string titles and statuses open or closed. issue_id must be a positive integer excluding booleans and must exist. changes must be a dict containing only title and/or status; an empty patch is valid for an existing issue. A new title must be a nonblank string and its exact supplied whitespace is preserved. A new status must be exactly open or closed. Every invalid ID, unknown ID, invalid patch type/key or invalid field value raises ValueError. Validate the entire patch before applying any change. Do not mutate issues, any input issue dictionary or changes, including when raising an error.

tasks.request: The first page skips the earliest issues. Fix page numbering, add regression tests, and review the complete change against the public contract.
Pages filtered by status contain too few issues even when enough matching issues exist. Fix the behavior, add regression tests, and review the complete change against the public contract.
Paging accepts invalid values and behaves inconsistently at boundaries. Fix validation and boundary behavior, add tests, and review the complete change against the public contract.
Label deduplication is inconsistent across whitespace and letter case, and the original order changes. Repair normalization and validation, add regression tests, and review the complete change.
Editing an issue mutates the caller's data and accepts forbidden changes. Repair the transactional update behavior, add regression tests, and review validation and mutation risks.
